character: a slim male kitsune fox-spirit, mid-thirties in appearance: silver-black fur dark through the coat with a cold silver wash at the temples and along a single bushy silver-tipped tail, one pointed fox ear out and the other tucked under dark hair, sharp clever amber eyes, a knowing half-smile showing a half-count too many teeth
wardrobe: a fine high-collared charcoal coat cut for movement, excellent well-worn boots, a signal-flag-red cravat, a heavy ring on the thumb
style: Painterly semi-realistic fantasy illustration, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, muted earthy palette with cool silver rim light, dark desaturated vignette background, no text, no frame, no watermark.

mj._note: Per-character Midjourney override: just the anthro description. Profile, style, version, raw and ow come from tools/imageGen/mj.defaults.json. MJ reads 'kitsune' as a human with fox ears, so spell out anthro/furry fox-folk here.
mj.character: an anthropomorphic fox character (anthro, furry), a bipedal humanoid fox-folk with a full fox head and muzzle and fur over the whole face and body; slim mid-thirties build; silver-black fur, dark through the body with a cold silver wash at the muzzle, brow and temples and along a single bushy silver-tipped fox tail; tall pointed fox ears, one upright and one tucked under dark head-hair; sharp clever amber eyes; a knowing toothy half-smile with a hint of sharp teeth

full.framing: Full-length character study, the figure standing at three-quarter turn, head to boots fully in frame, easy balance with weight on one foot like someone used to a moving deck, one hand resting near a coat pocket; plain dark studio backdrop.

portrait.framing: A tightly cropped head-and-shoulders portrait: the head and the tops of the shoulders fill the frame, cropped at the upper chest, the high coat collar and red cravat at the shoulders, the face turned to the viewer with a captain's watchfulness behind the poise. Close, intimate framing; only the head and shoulders, not the full body.

lowspan.framing: Three-quarter view, the figure seated at a worn card table at the rail of an underground fighting pit, a cup of dark spirits in one hand, half-watching a bout out of frame, the other hand loose on the table, back to the wall and eyes on the room; oil lamps on chains overhead, raw bridge-timber ceiling, sawdust and river damp, a blurred crowd beyond.
